question: Does continuous operating age add predictive information beyond five age bands?
scope: same 96 quarterly evaluation cohorts 2002-2025; no sampling
features: existing industry/gu/age_band plus quadratic spline of log1p(age_days/365.25)
spline: degree2 include_bias=False extrapolation=constant fixed knots; no evaluation-fitted transforms
model: LR C1 max_iter2000 seed7; same global/industry/region shrink500 calibration
split: train Jan1 year-4, calibration Jan1 year-2
comparison: raw-to-raw and calibrated-to-calibrated on same rows
limitations: Retrospective reused periods; fixed single candidate; no tuning or service update
